content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

The structural limitations imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe affect a significant number of digital creators around the world. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many without viable payment options. PayPal's account suspension policy can hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, further complicating financial stability for creators. These barriers are not just inconveniences; they represent systemic issues in digital commerce that require a fundamental shift in how creators operate. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent alternative that allows creators to maintain full control over their sales without fear of restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and accessible tools that work together to facilitate online transactions. Using platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Supabase for data management, creators can establish their online stores without the need for traditional payment processors. Additionally, services like NOWPayments enable automatic cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring that creators can receive payments without the risk of account freezes or limitations. This architecture is designed to be robust and scalable, allowing creators to manage everything from product listings to payment confirmations seamlessly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. This includes artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, who need reliable solutions to sell their digital products. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can bypass the limitations of traditional payment systems, ensuring that they retain full ownership of their data and sales. This empowers them to build sustainable businesses without relying on third-party platforms that can impose arbitrary restrictions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages, backend logic providers such as Google Apps Script, and order storage systems like Supabase or Google Sheets. Each component plays a critical role in ensuring the seamless operation of an online store. For instance, Cloudflare Workers can handle the backend logic, while NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, creating a streamlined experience for both the creator and their customers. This combination eliminates dependency on traditional platforms and provides a holistic solution for managing digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the appropriate stack, such as the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes all necessary components for a fully functional online store. Next, set up your hosting on Cloudflare Pages and configure your backend with Cloudflare Workers. Integrate Supabase for order management and implement NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, upload your digital products and configure your store settings. By following these steps, you can have your online store operational within 48 hours, allowing you to begin selling without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No account suspensions or holds—just seamless transactions.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
